QuestInfo.name: [Freud's Journal] The Ring's First Step
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Arnello. He wants to help you grow your ring.\r\n\r\n#rCaution! You must have the Sylph Ring in your inventory when you complete the quest.
QuestInfo.1: According to the Ring Growth Manual, the first thing you need to do is to connect with the ring. Arnello says you should spend some time with the ring by hunting monsters together.\r\n\r\n#rCaution! You must have the Sylph Ring in your inventory when you complete the quest.
QuestInfo.2: You've defeated about 999 monsters, which made the ring change form. It shared another memory of Freud, one of him granting the ring new power when he saw the survivors in Ossyria. He wished for the ring to be a loyal partner to someone, just as Afrien was to himself.
